newsitem.title: USA: Checkpoint stock tumbles on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Checkpoint stock tumbles on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of Checkpoint Systems Inc. lost more than 25 percent of its value Wednesday after the maker of electronic anti-theft surveillance systems warned that its third-quarter results would be below Wall Street's estimates.
Checkpoint fell $9.125 to $27.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.

The Thorofare, N.J.-based firm said late Tuesday that lost manufacturing time due to hurricane Hortense at its plant in Puerto Rico and delayed product rollout in supermarket chains would lower its earnings for the latest quarter by between 5 cents and 6 cents below analysts' estimates of about 20 cents a share.
The company earned 16 cents a share in the third quarter of 1995.
